pattern_summary: Dominant errors: review misrouting on clinical PDFs (7/10 publication_type) leaving exposure/cannabis/outcome empty; clinical oral/inhaled routes stripped by animal dedupe; sample_size from URL n= and population counts; administration_frequency from cannabis-use patterns on observational surveys; animal study_type bleed on human-participant PDFs; outcome_domain limited to abstract intro.
implementation_notes: should_route_clinical_before_review routes primary human-subjects surveys/RCT PDFs to original research before review cues.
Clinical oral/inhaled exposure routes are retained; animal-specific dedupe only when preclinical routes are present.
sample_size scoring rejects URL/reference n= and population stats; prefers participant cohort N= with total-N tie-break.
administration_frequency requires interventional dosing context on observational clinical designs.
Observational clinical papers skip duration_days; outcomes scan PDF intro/objective text.
Human-subject node2a routing strips incidental Animal Models labels from mixed branch hits.
